derivation.behavior: SAF/MediaStore/ContentResolver implement publication platform request with durable receipt.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Android broker performs physical commit while Go publication saga remains authoritative.

invariants: Android publication receipt survives process loss and prevents duplicate provider commit.
SAF document-tree destinations require a persistable permission grant before provider writes.
MediaStore-like destinations do not mutate engine state directly; they reply through the publication platform receipt.
Ambiguous provider success is reconciled by inspecting the durable receipt/provider idempotency key before any retry.
